_note: Starter set of Spanish (es) translations for agent display names. Mirrors scripts/i18n/agent-names-zh.json. This PR ships the most-common 30 entries (engineering, security, marketing) as a structural scaffold. A follow-up PR should expand to all 130+ entries — a native-Spanish-speaking reviewer should refine wording before merge. Keep keys identical to the English display name (used to look up the localized value); only the 'name' and 'description' values change. To use: install agents with install.sh, then run scripts/i18n/localize-agents-es.ps1.
